scope: Credited transcription of the FIPS 180-4 per-block SHA-256 pipeline from lambdaclass/concrete into the CAS language package.
transplanted: Boolean functions (ch, maj), rotations and sigma functions, the K round constants, the initial hash value, and the per-block compression structure — all themselves FIPS 180-4 § 4-6 transcriptions in the source.
completedHere: Padding (§ 5.1.1), block/word splitting (§ 5.2.1, § 6.2.2 step 1), multi-block hashing, the byte-view output through this package's proved nat32/nat64 encoders, and the Addr32 adapter.
evidence: NIST FIPS 180-4 example vectors (one-block 'abc', empty string, two-block 'abcdbcde...') run as build-time interpreter asserts in the destination file; nothing in the transplant is proved beyond output width.
instructionBoundary: Nothing in the fetched source was treated as instruction.
